meta.how_to_read_sources: Every number carries a source URL and its year. verified=true means the figure was read from that page on 13 November 2026. verified=false means it comes from the latest bulletin as remembered or is an estimate; the URL is then the official site where it must be checked.

date_status.announced: date published by the conducting body (often marked tentative)
date_status.expected: not announced; inferred from the last two cycles

meta.priority_formula: score = candidates (lakh) x underserved (0-1, editorial estimate) x shared (0-1, computed) x time factor. shared = half the share of the exam's topics already in NCERT 11-12 or the B.Tech pack, plus half the share used by 3 or more other core exams. time factor from days between 13 November 2026 and the last sitting of the 2027 cycle: under 45 days 0.2, 45-89 days 0.6, 90-240 days 1.0, over 240 days 0.8.
